rationale: All six blocking findings from the final round are resolved in the fix-up diff. CR-001: URL-origin guard added before jira.request(absolute=True); conftest updated so mock_jira.url is a real string. CR-002: 'or not response.content' clause removed; zero-byte files now handled correctly. CR-003: 'if copy_results:' guard prevents the no-op-violation summary append. CR-004: logger.info moved to the outer loop in copy_attachments_from_issue and fires for all status values (copied/failed/skipped); duplicate INFO removed from _copy_single_attachment. CR-005: regex updated to r'/rest/api/\d+/issue/?$' accepting optional trailing slash. CR-006: _JIRA_MARKUP_ESCAPE translation table at module level escapes wiki metacharacters in filenames; OCR text wrapped in {noformat} blocks via {{noformat}} f-string literals. Narrow new-issue scan: startswith bypass via crafted subdomain (e.g. jira.example.com.evil.com) noted but dismissed — Jira attachment content URLs are server-generated and not user-controllable without server-level compromise; defer-grade at most. ruff passes (0 violations); 145/145 tests pass.

finding_status.notes: URL-origin guard added: if not content_url.startswith(self.jira.url) → return None, 'failed'. conftest mock_jira.url set to string so existing tests exercise the guard.
Changed 'if response.status_code != 200 or not response.content:' to 'if response.status_code != 200:'. Zero-byte files (b'') no longer false-fail.
Wrapped response_string += block in 'if copy_results:'. No-op case (empty source) returns response_string unmodified.
logger.info added in copy_attachments_from_issue outer loop after _copy_single_attachment; fires for all status values. Duplicate logger.info inside _copy_single_attachment removed.
Regex changed from r"/rest/api/\d+/issue$" to r"/rest/api/\d+/issue/?$". Trailing slash now accepted.
_JIRA_MARKUP_ESCAPE = str.maketrans({...}) at module level escapes *, {, [, |, ~ in filenames. OCR text wrapped in {noformat} blocks via {{noformat}} f-string literals.
